name: Eating patterns of Somali families in the UK
what_people_do: Eat mainly rice, pasta and red meat with little fruit or vegetable; cultural beliefs about food shape the diet.
why_they_say_it_works: Familiar, filling foods; unsure what counts as healthy.

documented_by.source: Dietary beliefs and behaviour of a UK Somali population, 2009, J Hum Nutr Diet, PMID 19302117
documented_by.quote_or_summary: London, 8 focus groups (62 people) and 77 survey respondents: 97% ate fewer than two pieces of fruit and 92% fewer than two portions of vegetables a day; wish for education.

source.name: Dietary beliefs and behaviour of a UK Somali population, 2009, J Hum Nutr Diet, PMID 19302117

harm_note: Low fruit and vegetables is a general dietary risk, not a Somali-specific finding.
